title: Fish Further Charters
specs: Fish species include rockfish, yellowtail, bass, whitefish, sheep head, sculpin, barracuda, bonito, halibut, shark, lingcod, yellowfin tuna, and bluefin tuna
Rockfish charters use bottom fishing with live baits such as sardines, swim baits, squid
Rockfish are catchable year-round with some seasonal closures
Passports required for island trips to Coronado Islands in Mexico
Mexican fishing license required for some rockfish trips in Mexican waters
Kids as young as 3 years old have been on half-day inshore charters
Private charters for up to 4 people
includes: Waters, Gatorades, and light snacks such as chips and granola bars on island trips
blurb: Fish Further Charters offers private fishing charters for up to 4 people around San Diego, CA. They provide inshore fishing trips, island fishing trips to the Coronado Islands in Mexico, and offshore fishing trips. Species targeted include rockfish, yellowtail, bass, whitefish, sheep head, sculpin, barracuda, bonito, halibut, shark, lingcod, and tuna.
extraNote: Rockfish limit is 10 fish per person per day in Mexico and California · Stay up-to-date on rockfish spawning closures and restrictions
